summary: Letterhead verification across all 10 document types on Ramya test lead. 12/13 tests pass. NOC letterhead fix (HDFC/BOB/TATA) confirmed working — all 3 contain <div class="letterhead">, #D4AF37 gold border, RRL logo base64, and company name. payment_schedule auto-generate fix verified. interest_amount field persists via PUT /api/customers and renders in price_breakup. One genuine letterhead regression discovered: cost_breakup is silently dropping the RRL logo (HTML ~6.7KB, PDF only 17KB vs ~150KB for other docs).

critical.issue: cost_breakup HTML does NOT contain the RRL logo base64 (data:image/png;base64,iVBOR...). Template at /app/backend/documents/templates/cost_breakup.py imports get_logo_img_tag from common but never invokes it — the rendered header has only the company name text, no tag. This is the exact 'silently dropping letterhead' regression class the user is worried about. Resulting PDF is ~17KB (other docs are 150KB+), confirming the logo block is missing. Company name 'RRL Builders and Developers Pvt. Ltd.' IS present at line 316 of the template.

action_items: Fix cost_breakup template at /app/backend/documents/templates/cost_breakup.py — inject get_logo_img_tag(...) into the header block so cost_breakup matches the letterhead pattern used by allotment_letter, price_breakup, demand_letter, payment_schedule, and NOCs. After fix, re-run test_letterhead_iteration36.py::test_doc_has_letterhead_and_valid_pdf[cost_breakup] — should produce a PDF > 50KB.
(Optional) Consider extracting a single shared letterhead helper (like noc_templates._letterhead_html()) and reusing it across ALL doc templates so this class of regression cannot recur.
critical_code_review_comments: documents/templates/cost_breakup.py imports get_logo_img_tag but never calls it — silent dead import that hid the missing logo.

Each doc template re-implements its own header HTML, increasing risk that future templates also drop the letterhead. NOC templates already have a shared _letterhead_html() helper — the same pattern should be applied to all generators (sales_agreement, allotment_letter, price_breakup, cost_breakup, demand_letter, payment_schedule, payment_receipt).

documents/generators.py — admin DB override (db.document_templates) at the top of render_document_content silently replaces the built-in generator with whatever HTML is stored. A stale 44-byte template (TEST_refactor_template) left behind by iteration 28 was shadowing the real sales_agreement generator for all users in this preview env. Suggest: (a) add a guard that warns if override content is < some sane minimum, or (b) require explicit opt-in flag on overrides.

rca of the issue: cost_breakup regression — RCA: /app/backend/documents/templates/cost_breakup.py imports get_logo_img_tag at line 3 but the function is never invoked anywhere in generate_cost_breakup_html. The header in the generated HTML only writes the company name text. Repro: POST /api/documents/generate with doc_type=cost_breakup → HTML has no 'data:image/png;base64' substring and is ~6.7KB. PDF via GET /api/documents/pdf/{doc_id} is ~17KB. Mitigation: add `{get_logo_img_tag(120)}` into the header div in cost_breakup.py (mirror the pattern used in price_breakup.py and demand_letter.py), or refactor to use a shared letterhead helper.
